concepts.name: Folded core
concepts.description: Three broad planes compress the layered silicon idea into a compact symbol.
concepts.tradeoff: The closest logo-scale connection to the retained Silicon strata artwork.
concepts.alt: Compact ivory folded-layer logo with bold stepped planes and open negative space.
concepts.idea: Distill a stack of silicon layers into three broad interlocking folded planes, forming a compact almost hexagonal emblem with a small angular negative-space core. Two upper planes form a subtle V-shaped valley, one lower plane grounds it. Flat solid shapes only, like a clever paper fold suggested purely by cutout gaps, not perspective or tonal shading. Each plane substantial. Asymmetric one-corner offset gives the silhouette personality. No outlines and no floating chip stack illustration.
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE excellent compact original LOGO SYMBOL for Verity, a serious AI hardware engineering and verification developer tool. This must be a real usable symbol with the sophistication of a professional identity studio: an ownable solid silhouette, striking negative space, a clever structural idea, and very few geometric parts. ONE flat color only: warm ivory #F3EEE6 on perfectly solid warm near-black #0A0806. Square canvas, symbol centered and occupying about 55 percent of width and height with generous margin. Precise crisp clean vector-like edges. Deliberately bold enough to survive at 24 pixels, at most 3 or 4 substantial shapes, all gaps wide enough to remain open at small sizes. NO illustration, NO engraving, NO hatching, NO texture, NO tiny circuit detail, NO shading, NO 3D render, NO gradients, NO thin lines, NO mockups, NO diagram, NO multiple variants, NO wordmark, NO text, NO letters except where specifically described, NO watermark. Avoid generic square microchips with pins, checkmarks, shields, AI sparkles and stock icon appearance. Create a sophisticated logo through geometry and negative space, not by adding detail. The exact chosen Register cut wordmark will be paired separately by the gallery. concepts.name: Proof knot
concepts.description: Two paths lock together around one shared opening, suggesting designs that agree.
concepts.tradeoff: A distinctive abstract route that can stand without a literal chip symbol.
concepts.alt: Ivory angular interlocking-band logo around a shared central negative space.
concepts.idea: Two angular substantial bands interlock once around a shared off-center rectangular opening. Each band has one crisp diagonal bend and one squared terminal, their interplay suggests two independently built paths reaching the same answer. Compact vertical emblem, strong sculptural negative space. Show crossing order with just two wide background-colored cuts. NOT an infinity loop, NOT a chain link, NOT Celtic decoration, NOT a rounded app flower. Four visible filled regions maximum, a clever original geometric knot.

concepts.name: Signal weave
concepts.description: A few crossing bands turn routing into a woven diamond with an orderly center.
concepts.tradeoff: Its diagonal rhythm gives it more energy than the previous die symbols.
concepts.alt: Bold ivory woven-diamond logo with diagonal bands and square negative openings.
concepts.idea: Create an original compact woven diamond from four thick diagonal rectangular bands, two running down-right and two down-left, with precisely alternating wide cutout gaps where they cross. One clear central diamond-shaped negative opening and four short squared ends that make an unusual stepped silhouette. Solid geometric mass, deliberate optical balance, no thin stripes or lattice of many lines. A routed connection distilled into four bold bands, premium technical identity.

concepts.name: Offset die
concepts.description: A split, offset block uses one deliberate cut to make the silicon idea less literal.
concepts.tradeoff: The most restrained option, with the character carried by its negative-space cut.
concepts.alt: Bold offset chamfered ivory block logo split by a clean angular negative-space cut.
concepts.idea: An original solid compact chamfered block, divided into TWO interdependent pieces by a single wide angular stepped cut running from upper right toward lower left. Shift the upper piece slightly to create a distinctive offset shoulder, so the outside contour is not just a square. The central cut changes direction once, forming a subtle abstract V notch without showing a literal letter. Architectural, stampable and immediately recognizable. No surrounding frame, pins, outlines, fine details or conventional semiconductor chip icon.

concepts.name: Logic aperture
concepts.description: Three angular shutters converge around an open core, giving verification a focused form.
concepts.tradeoff: A more expressive symbol that keeps a simple one-color construction.
concepts.alt: Three bold ivory angular shutters arranged around a triangular negative-space center.
concepts.idea: Three unequal solid angular shutter-like pieces form a compact original aperture emblem around a generous triangular negative space. Not a camera icon: only THREE pieces, straight cut geometry, no ring, no curved blades, no hexagonal border. One upper vertical wedge and two lower bent wedges with squared terminals create a subtle off-center directional balance. The three pieces fit together as if precisely machined with very wide negative gaps. Smart convergence motif, bold minimal silhouette.

concepts.name: Trace V
concepts.description: Three thick paths turn the V into a routed signature with a clear overall outline.
concepts.tradeoff: The most direct link to the name, while keeping the circuit reference abstract.
concepts.alt: Ivory V monogram built from three thick angular routed paths with squared terminals.
concepts.idea: Create a distinctive substantial V monogram from exactly THREE thick parallel routed strokes. The strokes turn with one precise forty-five-degree chamfer and one right-angle return, sharing a deep lower turning point. Their squared terminals are staggered in length, creating a recognizable asymmetric upper edge. Between strokes leave wide clean dark channels. No terminal dots, no small squares, no circuit-board background. The whole symbol must read as ONE confident V from across a room while revealing three logical routes up close. Monoline thickness but extremely bold, not fine line art.
